subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into existing `replyToMode`/thread-session work, or rejected for now?
rationale: The code change is small, but the permanent user-facing config name and semantics affect compatibility, docs, generated metadata, and prior DM delivery safety behavior.

options.title: Decide API Then Complete Contract
options.body: Choose the intended config surface first, then require matching types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Separate DM Knob
options.body: Allow `dmThreadMode` as a new default-off Google Chat account key, with the remaining contract and proof work completed on this branch.

options.title: Consolidate With Thread Work
options.body: Pause or redirect this PR into the broader Google Chat thread/session routing work so the project does not ship competing option names.

recommendation.title: Decide API Then Complete Contract
recommendation.body: Choose the intended config surface first, then require matching types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and real Google Chat proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the prior DM-thread fix, verification, and Google Chat monitor behavior.
